settings.brightness: legacy StainTools brightness/luminosity standardization; 95th-percentile default; API-compatible implementation
settings.cache_position: after Macenko; before float32/255 and augmentation
settings.stain_options: installed defaults bound to backend source hashes

expected_storage.metadata_scope: Excludes JSON metadata, filesystem allocation units and temporary generation workspace

context.order: train manifest order, then internal_validation manifest order; no shard crosses a split

preprocessing_settings.brightness: legacy StainTools brightness/luminosity standardization; 95th-percentile default; API-compatible implementation
preprocessing_settings.cache_position: after Macenko; before float32/255 and augmentation
preprocessing_settings.stain_options: installed defaults bound to backend source hashes

disk_metric_scope: NPY bytes / generation wall time; not a block-device utilization measurement

estimate_comparison.comparison_scope: Stage 2E generation estimate was serial; Stage 2G uses four identical isolated workers. Full-loader measurement includes per-access integrity checks and full-dataset IO.

generation_timing_scope: Sum of perf_counter worker-pool session wall times; excludes preflight, committed-shard resume validation and final catalog/verification scans; downtime excluded

loader.augmentation: stateless train flips; no validation flips
loader.cache_temperature: uncontrolled OS cache after integrity audit; no cold-cache claim
loader.timing_scope: full input iteration, scaling/flips, host materialization, finite/order/label checks; no model

operational_changes: Optional cache-backed production path; preprocessing, model and scientific schedule unchanged.
Epoch-boundary model/Adam checkpoints added for safe production resume; no model selection or early stopping.
Dry-run checkpoint purpose is disposable and rejected by production resume.
All source reads are exact VAL1 paths from authenticated manifests; no VAL2 directory scan.

preflight.source_access: Exact authenticated VAL1 paths only, read_bytes/stat; no source writes or recursive discovery

caveats: Compute rates retain Stage 2E measurements; full production training was not benchmarked.
Primary estimate assumes input prefetch overlaps compute; serial bound adds both and may double-count part of Stage 2E input cost.
Checkpoint cost uses the first-stage dry-run write plus checksum verification for all 14 epoch checkpoints; serial bound allows 50% more for larger later-stage Adam state.
Not a confidence interval; thermal variation, background IO and compile/checkpoint variation remain possible.
Generation and integrity audit are one-time preparation and excluded from training-only hours.

production_recommendation: GO; recommendation only, production not started
stage2f_strict_parity: FAIL unchanged; numerical GPU GO remains a separate material-equivalence judgment
